beforeBoxes.text: Behaviour policies for the AI agents in Gmail, HR, payroll, CRM and meeting apps. Enforced in real time, with alerts by text and email.

afterBoxes.text: Agent Behaviour Policies for the AI agents in Gmail, HR, payroll, CRM and meeting apps: what each one can reach, what you authorised it to do, and the gap between the two. Your own controls enforce them. We are never in the request path.

beforeBoxes.text: Blocked: Payroll copilot tried to change bank details for 1 employee. Reply 1 to review.

afterBoxes.text: Blocked by your gateway: Payroll copilot tried to change bank details for 1 employee. Reply 1 to review.

The gate in the middle is your gateway, proxy or IAM, configured from the rules in the ABP. RiskMandate writes the rules and is never in the request path; the approval card is a flow your team stands up with our help.

pairs.title: Pick a system, set the rules

beforeBoxes.text: Every system starts from a template. Decide what agents can do, what waits for approval and what never happens. The rules you can paste into an agent today, one worry at a time, are here.

afterBoxes.text: Every system starts from a template. Decide what agents can do, what waits for approval and what never happens. We write it down; your controls enforce it. The rules you can paste into an agent today, one worry at a time, are here.

beforeBoxes.text: Bring your policy. We make it enforceable.
Upload the document legal already wrote. We turn every line into a rule, supply the business logic behind it, and flag what can't be enforced as written.

afterBoxes.text: Bring your policy. We show what can enforce it.

Upload the document legal already wrote. We turn every line into a rule, supply the business logic behind it, name the control in your stack that would enforce each one, and flag what nothing can enforce as written.

beforeBoxes.text: A prompt asks. A policy enforces.
Instructions inside an agent can be ignored or talked around. Rules outside it can't.

afterBoxes.text: A prompt asks. A boundary enforces.
Instructions inside an agent can be ignored or talked around. A control outside it cannot, and the ABP says which of the two each rule has.
In the ABP, held by your gateway

beforeBoxes.text: Every policy alerts the right person by text and email. Approve or deny with a one-letter reply.

afterBoxes.text: An approval flow your team stands up with our help, from the rules in the ABP: the right person gets a text and an email, and approves or denies with a one-letter reply. It runs in your stack, not ours.
